04 Schedule

When it happened,
and how long it took.

Every job on one calendar. Days on site and cost sit beside each one; hours and miles appear as soon as they are recorded.

06 Premise

Jobs change while
they happen.

A wall opens up and something is behind it. A part costs more than the quote. This hub keeps the record as the job moves, so the number at the end is backed by what actually happened.

  1. 01

    The record backs the claim.

    Every change during a job is logged with its date, its reason, its amount and a photo, then carried into the ledger.

  2. 02

    Missing is marked, never guessed.

    A number that was not recorded says so. Totals tell you how many jobs they are built from.

  3. 03

    The work is public. The money is kept apart.

    Photos, timelines and tasks form the portfolio. Each project's ledger lives in its own record, separate from the rest.
